hooks.name: team-memory-pull
hooks.description: Pull the latest shared memory, register the Basic Memory project, refresh the skill copies, and report any notes flagged review_needed by a planning change. Output is added to the agent's context. Kiro IDE only: SessionStart is not available on Kiro CLI or Web, where you run `uv run -q --script scripts/sync-memory.py pre` by hand.

hooks.name: team-memory-session
hooks.description: Open a fresh session ledger so `mem load` knows what this session has already read. Kiro sends no session id, so the ledger is per checkout (one Kiro session at a time per repo).
